name: Alt Text Generator Helper
description: Write clear, descriptive alt text for your images from a short description — template-based, no AI calls, fully in your browser.
body:
Generated alt text

Your alt text will appear here.

Best practices

  • Describe the image specifically and factually.
  • Keep it under ~125 characters.
  • Include your target keyword naturally, not awkwardly.
  • Decorative images can use empty alt text (alt="").
howto: Describe what the image shows in plain words.
Choose the context — general, product, tutorial or decorative.
Review the suggested text and edit it to match your page.
Copy it into the alt attribute of your image.
features: Context-aware alt text suggestions (general, product, tutorial)
Decorative-image guidance with empty alt handling
Runs on-device — no AI API, no uploads

faq.a: Alt text makes images accessible to screen readers and shows when images fail to load. It also gives search engines context for image SEO.

faq.q: Is this using an AI model?
faq.a: No. It builds the text from templates and your description on your device. It is a helper, so always review and tailor it to your actual image.

faq.q: Should every image have alt text?
faq.a: Informative images need descriptive alt text. Decorative images should use empty alt text (alt="") so screen readers skip them.

faq.q: How long should alt text be?
faq.a: Aim for under 125 characters. It should be concise but descriptive — a few words to a short sentence.
